items.text: General split-shell — Config → General now uses a sticky quick links sidebar next to the settings content, same split-shell pattern as Stats and Help; the sidebar highlights the section currently in view as you scroll.

Section accordion — opening a section (via the sidebar or its own title) collapses whichever other section was open, so only one stays expanded. Clicking the link for an already-open, in-view section collapses it again; clicking the link for an open section scrolled out of view scrolls back to it instead.
Advanced split further — Search & input, System & tools, and a standalone Tours & onboarding card replace one long Advanced block.
Number input styling — Offline retries, Retry delay, and Minimum bookmarks per tag steppers now match the themed background and button styling used elsewhere, like Columns per row.

Lazy-load stalling — this modal's own scroll-to-load-more could silently stop fetching further releases after the first one, or freeze entirely if it was opened twice in a row (e.g. an automatic unread-release prompt racing a manual ★ click). Fixed on both counts — you're reading this via the fix.
